notes: Desktop unit, not rack-mountable (333 W x 107.9 H x 414.2 D mm, 8.0 kg); rackUnits omitted. Power: AC 100-240V 50/60Hz, 60W (0.4W standby). Ports extracted directly from the manufacturer's Operating Instructions manual rear-panel/control-panel diagrams and part-name lists (pp.6-10). PHONO/LINE/DIGITAL/MASTER1/MASTER2/BOOTH/REC OUT/SEND/RETURN are each physically a stereo (L/R) pair of jacks represented here as one logical port per channel. Digital I/O (DIGITAL IN x4, DIGITAL MASTER OUT) uses coaxial RCA jacks carrying S/PDIF — no bandwidth grade applies to RCA per the connector-grade rules. AC inlet is a rear IEC-style receptacle; exact C13/C14 designation not printed in the manual, approximated as "iec". The two top-panel USB ports (labeled A/B, for connecting up to two computers) are USB Type-B, USB 2.0 per manual instructions ("use USB cables that conform to USB 2.0"). A third "Mobile device connection terminal" USB port (near SEND/RETURN) is documented only as accepting "the cable supplied with the [mobile] device" — its exact physical USB sub-type is not explicitly stated in the manual; approximated here as USB-A (common convention for this 2016-era product) and its speed grade is omitted since not stated. Four per-channel SIGNAL GND screw-terminal lugs (chassis ground for turntables) exist near the phono inputs but are omitted since "ground lug" is not one of the allowed connector types.

ports.name: SEND

ports.name: Mobile device connection terminal

ports.name: AC IN
ports.note: Mains power inlet, AC 100-240V 50/60Hz, 60W (0.4W standby); use only the included power cord.
